messages:
maya: heads-up — i'm planning a small config + metrics tweak deploy to serving tomorrow 10:30am PT. @sanjay you're the deploy owner, can you confirm timing and rollback window?

sanjay: yes, i'm up for that window. deploy is ~10m, will run migration for qcache and add a new panel to the model-latency dashboard. rollback window 15 mins after deploy if anything odd.

maya: thanks. can we list the smoke checks you'd like us to run? i'll be on watch for alerts.

sanjay: smoke checks:
- curl health on /health (expect 200) across 3 regions
- prometheus error-rate < 0.5% in 5m after deploy
- median p50 token latency within +15% of baseline
- KV cache hitrate not dropping > 10%

lucas: adding the two dashboard changes: new panel for tokenization time and a trace sampling tweak. i'll push the grafana change as a separate patch and pin to the deploy id so we can revert independently.

kelly_oncall: i'll be on call for the window. quick question: what alert thresholds are we adjusting? we should avoid noisy pages.

sanjay: plan is to temporarily relax the alert for model-timeout from 5m->8m for 20 minutes post-deploy (so transient GC does not fire). also raise the error-rate paging threshold from 0.5% -> 1.0% during the immediate 10m to reduce churn, we'll revert after smoke window.

maya: please put those temporary threshold changes in the deploy notes and tag me. also leave exact prometheus queries.

sanjay: yes, will add. prometheus queries: 
- error rate: (increase(http_requests_errors_total[5m]) / increase(http_requests_total[5m])) * 100
- p50 token latency: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] service-serving v2.14 by @sanjay scheduled for 2024-06-22T17:30:00Z. Rollback policy: manual. Watchers: maya, kelly_oncall, lucas.

lucas: for traces — i'll bump sample rate from 0.2 -> 0.5 for the canary group only. will tag traces with deploy_id so we can filter quickly. also added a dashboard link: https://grafana.company/r/model-latency?orgId=1

kelly_oncall: reminder for watch checklist: 
1) run curl health across three regions: 
   ```bash
   for r in us-west us-east eu-west; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://$r-serving.internal/health; done
   ```
2) run prometheus ad-hoc queries (link: https://prometheus.company/graph)
3) check traces for 5 slow samples in 10m for deploy_id

maya: perfect. can folks ack their responsibilities? i'll be coordinating the rollback if needed.

sanjay: ack — deploy owner, will monitor rollout and post roll-forward timestamp.

lucas: ack — dashboard and trace changes, will be on standby to revert grafana patch.

kelly_oncall: ack — oncall watch, will escalate if error-rate > 1% sustained for 10m or p50 latency > threshold +20%.

maya: thanks. i'll post a short post-deploy summary in #deploys once we close the watch. :thumbsup:
